contracts: (Absent-path invocation terminates with invalid-input rejection and independent witness recorded.) AND (Traversal invocation terminates with invalid-input rejection and independent witness recorded.)
selector_intents: Use the absent-path selector with a target path that does not exist; the invocation must fail if invalid-input rejection is missing.
Use the traversal selector with an escaping target path; the invocation must fail if traversal is not rejected as invalid-input.
